data_region.title: Data Region
data_region.description: The Intercom region for your app. Options - empty string (US/default), 'eu' (Europe), 'au' (Australia). Based on your Intercom app URL (app.intercom.io for US, app.eu.intercom.io for EU, app.au.intercom.io for AU). Cannot be changed after initial connection creation.

access_token.description: The long-lived `Access Token` carries the information necessary for API resources to fetch data.
